The '''Vectinia system''' was located in the [[Hewett sector/Legends|Hewett sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was linked via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Hewett system/Legends|Hewett system]] as well as the [[Tartaglia system/Legends|Tartaglia system]] in the [[Hollan sector/Legends|Hollan sector]].<ref name="EGTW" />

The Vectinia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was home to the [[Species/Legends|species]] known as [[Vectinian spider]]s.<ref name="GSW1" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], it fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vectinia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-7.<ref name="TEA" />
